Subject: Vendor setup / next steps from today's call

Hi Irene — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can get Finance moving: 

- MedLink needs a vendor packet and tax forms (W-9 for US vendors / W-8BEN-E if non-US).
- We require banking instructions for ACH/wire, and a contact for invoice routing in Redwood's AR team.
- Procurement prefers PO-based purchases (Net30) where possible; we do accept card for pilot purchases under $5k. Can you confirm Redwood's preferred buying path?
- We're exploring marketplace enrollment (AWS Marketplace) — does Redwood support seller onboarding there and how long does that typically take?

Attached is our internal vendor intake PDF we fill out (medlink_vendor_intake_blank.pdf) — we'll complete and return once we confirm the required Redwood docs.

Thanks — Julia

Hi Julia — great speaking with you. Below is a concise list of what we need from MedLink and what Redwood will provide to speed vendor activation.

What Redwood needs (from MedLink):
- Completed vendor intake (the PDF you attached) — please return as PDF or via the Drive link below.
- Company legal name for invoicing, remit-to address, and ACH/Wire banking details (bank name, routing, account number, beneficiary name).
- W-9 (for US org) or W-8BEN-E (if applicable).

What Redwood will provide (attachments/links):
- Redwood vendor packet (attached): vendor setup form, data processing addendum, and our vendor banking instructions for remittance.
- Redwood W-9 (attached).
- DocuSign vendor agreement (optional) if you prefer e-signature: https://docusign.com/tx/AB12CD34
- Drive folder to upload completed intake: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVendorOnboarding

Buying path & marketplace:
- We support PO purchases (Net30) and card payments; for recurring production commitments we typically route to a purchase order for accounting reasons.
- Marketplace enrollment (AWS, Azure) is supported but requires additional seller onboarding and legal review; timeline is commonly 4–6 weeks after paperwork is complete.

Next steps: 
1) If PO is preferred, confirm billing name + PO terms (Net30/Net45).
2) You return the completed intake + W-9 to the Drive folder or attach to your reply.
3) We'll initiate vendor creation in our Finance system and confirm the vendor ID.

I've attached: Redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf, Redwood_W-9.pdf. 

If helpful, I can also loop in our Finance ops lead to accelerate setup — Ben, can you take point once we have the completed intake?

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Commercial Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf; Redwood_W-9.pdf
